data.cta: H-Nail Fungus Formula sells out fast, so don't wait. 90-day money-back guarantee. Button: Shop Now to amoils.com/products/nail-fungus.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: The three-person test is a simple story with a clear winner, and naming the exact alternatives the viewer has tried (cream, vinegar, tea tree) puts her inside it. The sandals and 'stop hiding your feet' payoff turns a nail problem into confidence.
data.transferable_move: Stage a three-way trial: the usual product, the popular home hack, and yours; show each result, then explain why only yours worked. Do not copy an unverified 'experiment'; film a real one. Soften: 'clearer-looking nails'.
